title: Miriam
summary: Sister of Moses and Aaron, a prophetess (Exod 15:20); died at Kadesh (Num 20:1).

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Ussher, Annals of the World (1650/1658) prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (2552c AM, 1452 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

birth.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.
No birth year. Ussher §264 says she was the eldest of the three and "lived 130 years", which implies about AM 2422, but Ussher does not print that year.

birth.date: which continued vpon her seuen daies

birth.note: Body intake. How long he says the leprosy continued. Not her lifespan, and not the year of her death. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.

birth.note: He names Miriam at the basket and Paheri as the tutor. No year is printed for either.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §264 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
death.note: "Miriam died ... 4 months before her brother Aaron ... She was the oldest of the three and lived 130 years."

death.date: Israel arrived at Kedesh in the 1st month, and that Miriam died at that time.
death.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 6)," Biblical Chronology 6:8 (August 1994), §18 "The Years 2553 and 2554."
